limits: Exact evaluator input map is authoritative; all 27 listed artifact hashes matched. Only this case’s original brief/plan, mapped files and declared source roots were assessed.
N2 authored final received complete six-axis source-grounded review; N1 all available stages received independent six-axis review but its final remains missing.
No candidate repair, source-map rebinding, product intervention, Git/canon/account/config change, downloaded executable or nested delegation.

Independent primary retrievals are dated and hashed; mutable main/live sources may differ from the frozen candidate captures. Released Whisper source corroborates the important default rather than assuming all drift occurred during the interval.
A successful HTTP status is not treated as source truth: unusable FCC/eCFR pages are explicitly qualified and an official released CFR comparator is separately recorded.
The current BBC page is accessible during this assessment and linked by the candidate’s WAI source. This does not prove every network route was available at every candidate timestamp.
No actual site/video/translation/player accessibility test was run. Assessment is of research and proposed validations, not implementation acceptance.
